meta.name: La vida a color con David Attenborough
meta.description: Con tecnología innovadora, esta docuserie explora la naturaleza desde una nueva perspectiva y muestra cómo los animales usan los colores para sobrevivir.

videos.title: Seeing in Colour
videos.overview: Using the latest camera technology, David Attenborough reveals the extraordinary ways in which animals use colour: to win a mate, to fight off rivals and to warn enemies.

videos.title: Hiding in Colour
videos.overview: David Attenborough reveals the extraordinary ways that some animals use colour to hide and disappear into the background.

videos.title: Chasing Color
videos.overview: The crew shares how they captured views of a hidden world across various habitats and challenging conditions using a pioneering camera system.
